signatures.admissibleFunction_iff: (f : ℝ → ℝ) : AdmissibleFunction f ↔ (0 ≤ f 0 ∧ ∀ x y θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ x → 0 ≤ y → 0 ≤ θ → θ ≤ 1 → θ * f x + (1 - θ) * f y ≤ f (θ * x + (1 - θ) * y))
signatures.functionalCalculus_eq_spectral: {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) (f : ℝ → ℝ) : functionalCalculus f A = (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) * Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (f (hA.eigenvalues i) : ℂ)) * (hA.eigenvectorUnitary : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ).conjTranspose
signatures.functionalCalculus_congr_nonneg: {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hA : A.PosSemidef) (f g : ℝ → ℝ) (hfg : Set.EqOn f g (Set.Ici 0)) : functionalCalculus f A = functionalCalculus g A
signatures.quadratic_cfc: {n : ℕ} (A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℂ) (hA : A.IsHermitian) : functionalCalculus witnessFunction A = A - A ^ 2
